svg.text: owner Vedam · Verilog-2001 · parameters: DEF_EN=0, DEF_WD_EN=0
Decides whether the motors may move. Fail-safe: any doubt ⇒ pwm_enable_o = 0 within ≤ 2 clk; faults latch; re-arm is deliberate.
REGISTER BANK · base 0x10005000 · ID 0x53414601 · reads are registered (valid next cycle)
Debounce: tilt 3 samples, never for E-stop. Re-arm: clear flags, condition gone, ARM low then high. After reset DISARMED. Watchdog off by default (phase 1 has no CPU).
